scope: Local workerd using the recorded transport; host-generated real Parquet fixture; fresh isolate per capacity/concurrency scenario. Runtime.getHeapUsage sampled approximately every 5ms while requests run; samples are lower bounds on peaks, not enforced Cloudflare production heap limits. No forced GC during measured rounds; diagnosticGc optionally collects only after final eviction. In materialized/owned mode output rows are pinned through a post-query snapshot then explicitly released; stream mode keeps only checksums. Only checksums leave Worker. Pool bounds cover tracked allocations only. Optional runtimeHeapMiB supplies a verified V8 managed-heap flag, not a cap on external buffers, total process memory, or production Cloudflare accounting. Raw JS/embedder/backing counters retained separately; no assumed additive total.
